message.content: {"skills": [{"slot": 1, "name": "Feed 导出格式选择与配置", "description": "根据目标输出格式选择对应的 FEEDS format 值并配置导出器，覆盖 JSON、JSON lines、CSV、XML、Pickle、Marshal 等内置格式。适用于需要将抓取到的 item 序列化输出到文件或存储的场景。", "asset_type": "session_skill", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "granularity": "session", "objective": "为抓取结果选择并配置正确的序列化导出格式", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export", "method_family": "format_configuration", "stage": "output_configuration", "use_when": ["需要将 item 导出为指定格式", "需要为 CSV 指定列顺序或列名"], "do_not_use_when": ["仅需内存处理无需落盘输出"], "success_artifact": "已配置 format 键与对应导出器的 FEEDS 设置", "why_distinct": "聚焦格式选择与导出器映射，区别于存储后端配置", "evidence_span_hint": "Value for the `format` key in the `FEEDS` setting", "confidence": 0.85}, {"slot": 2, "name": "Feed 存储后端 URI 配置", "description": "通过 FEEDS 设置使用一个或多个 URI 定义 feed 存储位置，并按 URI scheme 选择本地文件系统、FTP、S3、GCS 或标准输出等存储后端。适用于需要将导出结果写入特定存储位置的场景。", "asset_type": "session_skill", "asset_node_id": "workflow_skill", "granularity": "session", "objective": "为 feed 导出配置正确的存储后端与 URI", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export", "method_family": "storage_backend_configuration", "stage": "output_configuration", "use_when": ["需要将 feed 写入远程或本地存储", "需要多目标存储输出"], "do_not_use_when": ["仅需选择序列化格式而存储位置已确定"], "success_artifact": "已按 URI scheme 配置好存储后端的 FEEDS 设置", "why_distinct": "聚焦存储位置与后端选择，区别于序列化格式选择", "evidence_span_hint": "you define where to store the feed using one or multiple URIs", "confidence": 0.8}]}
